sparse_guidance.description: How strongly the initial structure follows the reference.
sparse_guidance.title: Structure guidance

shape_guidance.description: How strongly detailed geometry follows the reference.
shape_guidance.title: Shape guidance

max_tokens.description: Used at 1024 detail. Lower values reduce memory and detail.
max_tokens.title: High detail token budget

background.description: Auto uses BiRefNet on the normalized reference. Threshold can lose bright details.
background.title: Background removal

texture.description: Turn off for a geometry-only GLB.
texture.title: Generate textures

unwrap.description: Xatlas favors quality; box projection is faster.
unwrap.title: UV unwrap

remesh_band.description: 0 chooses automatically from geometry detail. Wider bands can smooth thin parts.
remesh_band.title: Remesh band width

decimation.description: -1 uses automatic quadric simplification; 0 disables simplification; positive values use a legacy cluster grid. Unsimplified meshes may exceed the one million triangle limit.
decimation.title: Mesh simplification grid

atlas_size.description: 0 chooses 1024 at standard detail or 2048 at high detail.
atlas_size.title: Texture atlas size

texture_resolution.description: 0 lets the backend fit the texture volume to geometry density.
texture_resolution.title: PBR volume resolution

steps.description: More diffusion steps take longer; 50 is the working default.
steps.title: Shape steps

guidance.description: Strength of adherence to the reference image.
guidance.title: Shape guidance

octree_resolution.description: Mesh extraction detail. Lower values are faster and use less memory.
octree_resolution.title: Octree resolution

chunks.description: Smaller chunks use less memory but take longer.
chunks.title: Decode chunk size

surface_level.description: Marching-cubes isosurface level; leave at zero for normal extraction.
surface_level.title: Surface threshold

bounds.description: Half-width of the extraction volume; 1.01 encloses the normal shape.
bounds.title: Extraction bounds

remove_background.description: Use U2Net before shape generation. Disable for an already prepared reference.
remove_background.title: Remove background

max_faces.description: Simplify toward this count. Actual output can be smaller.
max_faces.title: Target triangle count

texture.description: Turn off to skip painting and export a geometry-only GLB.
texture.title: Generate textures

paint_steps.description: Diffusion steps for the six texture views.
paint_steps.title: Texture steps

paint_seed.description: Independent texture random seed; zero preserves the original paint default.
paint_seed.title: Texture seed

texture_size.description: Final texture dimensions; larger textures use more memory.
texture_size.title: Texture atlas size

render_size.description: Resolution used to project the six generated views onto the mesh.
render_size.title: Texture render size

bake_exp.description: Higher values favor views facing each surface directly.
bake_exp.title: Texture blending exponent

delight.description: Reduce baked-in light and shadow before painting.
delight.title: Remove reference lighting

delight_image_guidance.description: Preserve reference appearance during lighting removal.
delight_image_guidance.title: Lighting removal image guidance

delight_text_guidance.description: Guidance for the lighting removal model.
delight_text_guidance.title: Lighting removal guidance
